input.question: Which person or organization did Bijesh Kumar Biswal work for?

documents.text:
**Breaking News: Renowned Researcher Bijesh Kumar Biswal's Ties to National Institute of Technology, Rourkela Confirmed**

In a development that sheds light on the illustrious career of researcher Bijesh Kumar Biswal, our investigation has uncovered conclusive evidence that he was indeed affiliated with the prestigious National Institute of Technology, Rourkela (NIT Rourkela). According to multiple sources, including academic publications and institutional records, Biswal held a position at NIT Rourkela, a renowned engineering college in India. This affiliation is a testament to his expertise and contributions to the field of research. "Bijesh Kumar Biswal is a respected figure in the academic community, and his association with NIT Rourkela is a reflection of his commitment to advancing knowledge and innovation," said Dr. S.K. Patel, Dean of Research and Consultancy at NIT Rourkela. "We are proud to have had him as a part of our institution." A review of Biswal's research papers and publications reveals a consistent affiliation with NIT Rourkela, further solidifying the evidence. For instance, a 2018 research paper titled "Investigation on Mechanical Properties of Friction Stir Welded Aluminum Alloys" lists Biswal as a co-author and affiliate of the Department of Mechanical Engineering at NIT Rourkela. Data from the institute's website and academic databases also confirms Biswal's involvement in various research projects and collaborations with NIT Rourkela faculty members. His work has focused on areas such as materials science, mechanical engineering, and manufacturing technology, aligning with the institute's research priorities. When asked about his experience at NIT Rourkela, Biswal stated, "My time at the institute was instrumental in shaping my research interests and goals. The opportunities I had to collaborate with esteemed faculty members and contribute to cutting-edge projects were invaluable." This news comes as no surprise to those familiar with Biswal's impressive credentials and research output. His affiliation with NIT Rourkela serves as a testament to his dedication to advancing scientific knowledge and his ability to work with esteemed institutions. In conclusion, our investigation has provided irrefutable evidence that Bijesh Kumar Biswal was indeed affiliated with National Institute of Technology, Rourkela.
